user.title: Set up Conversation Router
user.description: Creates one conversation agent that forwards each request to whichever underlying agent you configure. After setup, open this integration's Configure dialog to set the default agent and routing rules.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Conversation Router is needed - configure its rules from the integration's options instead of adding another.

init.title: Conversation Router rules
init.description: Rules are checked in order. The first rule whose condition evaluates to true picks the agent used for that request. If no rule matches (or none are set), the default agent is used. Conditions are Jinja templates, e.g. checking whether a connectivity binary_sensor is on or off. Fallback: if a fallback agent is set, any reply from the chosen agent that is an error or whose speech matches one of the fallback patterns (one regular expression per line, case-insensitive) is treated as "not understood" and the same request is sent to the fallback agent instead. Clear the patterns box to fall back on errors only.

data.default_agent: Default agent (used when no rule matches)
data.fallback_agent: Fallback agent (used when the chosen agent does not understand)
data.fallback_on_error: Fall back when the chosen agent returns an error response
data.fallback_patterns: "Not understood" reply patterns (one regex per line)
data.grounding_check: Grounding pre-check (Sophia NLU only): send to the fallback agent when Sophia's match doesn't explain every word
data.grounding_extra_words: Extra words the grounding check ignores (space or newline separated)

error.invalid_pattern: One of the fallback patterns is not a valid regular expression.
